Title: Deckard Hotfix Patch #1
Subtitle: Hotfix
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Dragon Shire ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] ~~Fixed an issue that caused Time Stop effects to fail to pause channels on the Dragon Knight.~~

=== Battlegrounds: Towers of Doom ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Time Stop effects to fail to pause channels on Towers of Doom's Altars.

=== Battlegrounds: Warhead Junction ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Time Stop effects to fail to pause channels on Warheads.

=== Heroes: Deckard ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Rejuvenation Potion no longer restores resources other than Mana, such as Zarya's Energy and Sonya's Fury.
  • Heroes who are Unstoppable can now correctly consume Lesser Healing Potions.
  • Replaced an outdated voiceover line that could play after repeatedly clicking Deckard in the Taiwanese game client.

=== Heroes: Garrosh ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Enemies within line of sight blockers who are hit by Groundbreaker at maximum range are now correctly revealed.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Learning Crash Lightning no longer causes Chain Lightning to prioritize Heroes prior to earning 30 Crash Lightning stacks.
